args.query: strongest evidence the three captured VEHICLE labels resolve through the language archive

candidates.text: Each car's INGAME_TEXT_ENUM is read from the reference CARDATA block and equals the bridge enum.
Each enum key resolves in tlate_en.dat;1 to a string equal to the on-screen label.
The resolved string's raw UTF-16-LE bytes occur verbatim in the archive, including the 0x27 apostrophe.
bridge-three-screens.json is updated with the resolved rows only when all three pass.
